method.inference: None. Cached probabilities only; each cache's rows_sha256 is checked against the rows file before it is used.
method.scope: ML tier only. Rules tier and semantic veto are excluded, so these are not product recall/FPR -- the product path scores differently in both directions.
method.unmeasurable: A criterion this set cannot measure is reported UNMEASURABLE and is never counted as a pass.

cpu_p95_as_deployed.note: p95 of batch-one CPU inference at the deployed fixed 256-token padding.

cpu_p95_dynamic_padding_projection.note: p95 with dynamic padding, which is NOT implemented in lib/ml/bertTokenizer.ts; a projection from the same cached probe, not a deployed measurement.

input_window.note: Spec asks for p95 at inputs up to 4k tokens. The content window is 254 tokens (ML_ONNX_MAX_LENGTH=256 minus CLS/SEP) and ML_ONNX_SLIDING_WINDOW is off, so latency at 4k tokens is not defined for this artifact and was not measured.

1_latency.caveat: Inference only. Excludes tokenization, rules tier, semantic veto and transport.

2_strongest_in_market.note: No competitor has been scored on these rows. A head-to-head needs each competitor run through this same battery and decision contract.
2_strongest_in_market.history: ProtectAI's DeBERTa has previously beaten SoterAI on a like-for-like corpus; the in-repo ranking docs asserting otherwise were withdrawn.

f1.note: Binary attack-vs-safe F1 at the evaluated gate.

auc_roc.note: Threshold-free, on P(attack)=1-P(SAFE). Independent of the gate.

indirect/RAG injection.note: Taxonomy has ['RAG_POISONING'] but this battery contains no rows for it.

encoding (base64/unicode/leetspeak/homog.note: Taxonomy has ['ENCODING_OBFUSCATION'] but this battery contains no rows for it.

multi-turn / context accumulation.note: Taxonomy has ['MULTI_TURN_ESCALATION'] but this battery contains no rows for it.

tool-call / agentic injection.note: Taxonomy has ['TOOL_CALL_ABUSE'] but this battery contains no rows for it.

model extraction.note: Taxonomy has ['MODEL_EXTRACTION'] but this battery contains no rows for it.

data exfiltration.note: Taxonomy has ['DATA_EXFILTRATION_ATTEMPT'] but this battery contains no rows for it.

payload splitting.note: No taxonomy label expresses this family, so no row can evidence coverage.

4_attack_coverage.note: A family passes only when it has enough rows to measure, is admitted to the production INPUT allowlist, and clears the recall floor.

languages_present.note: Distinct annotated languages with any row in this battery.

languages_with_benign_rows.note: Languages carrying at least one benign row. Below this count, per-language FPR cannot be measured at all, whatever the attack-side coverage says.

5_languages.note: Eval-set coverage only. Training-corpus language coverage is a separate claim and is not evidenced by this file. FLORES-200 is not used here.

6_recall_and_fpr.note: Reported together on the same rows at the same gate, as the spec requires.

ood_layer.note: Artifact ships an out-of-distribution entropy budget consumed by the abstention path.

continual_learning.note: No continual-learning trigger is wired: models are retrained as discrete, manually launched runs per version (scripts/ml/train-soterllm-*.py). Nothing promotes a model, or ingests production misses into a corpus, without a human starting it.

language_recall_spread.note: max-min recall spread across 7 languages with >= 30 attack rows.

reproducible.note: Rows, model, tokenizer, calibration and decision-layer digests all recorded.
